changelog: 5.0.6-beta.3: Faster cached lookups with verified embed IDs, provider-scoped caches, safer fallback language checks and preserved external audio/subtitle playlists. Stops returning unrelated videos when embed metadata is unavailable. Owner-approved LIVE BETA: sampled media, runtime and regression checks passed; full certification and native phone acceptance remain pending. S2 retains the same opening-language detector flag observed on the previous live build. Existing source availability and backup-only-Dub limitations remain.

5.0.5-beta.7: Updates provider response and token handling, same-episode/audio checks and Retry-After handling. Experimental owner-requested live-test release: repeated-open failures and source/DNS availability remain unresolved. Do not treat this as a certified reopen fix.

5.0.5-beta.2: Restores stream resolution on the current rescue CDN routes (Sub and Dub). Fixes titles failing to load on the released app by raising the in-app probe budget (2MB to 4MB), extending the resolution deadline (3s to 5s), accepting size-capped reachability, and preferring routes without player-broken segment names. Subtitle tracks unchanged; verified on the released app runtime and S2.

5.0.4-beta.4: Fixed random skipping during playback (disguised .html segments mapped and served as genuine MPEG-TS video/mp2t). AES-CBC player stream descriptor decrypt support, improved fallback rate-limit handling, and normalized subtitle language tags.

5.0.4-beta.3: Vidhawk-independent AniKage rescue chain (labelled; used only when the primary has no verified media), MegaPlay descriptor decrypt fix, MAL-keyed rescue lookups, subtitle language tags. Fixes titles that went dark during the Vidhawk media-relay outage.

5.0.4-beta.3: Rescue routes pass the same positive media validation as primary routes and are never substituted across languages; episodes the rescue chain does not carry remain unavailable with an honest message.

1.1.3: Playback restored. The source now hands back an opaque token instead of a direct URL and the module discarded it as "not a URL", so every provider looked dead. Tokens are expanded through the source's own proxy now, the live providers (wave/koto/megg) are tried first, and quality labels come from the stream itself (720p/360p) instead of a bare Auto. Verified on the exact bytes: release gate ALL_PASSED.

1.1.2: Owner-approved public release — restored playback: the player host shipped an encrypted stream descriptor (now decrypted in-module, cross-verified), and segments are classified by bytes (the CDN serves real video behind .jpg/webp labels) instead of content-type.
1.1.2: Resolution/validation caches and request dedupe keep normal browsing inside the source's request budget; verified live — streams resolve, zero 429s, app-runtime playback passes.
1.1.1: Owner-approved distribution of the unchanged testing package. Retains its beta label; not fully certified.
1.1.1: Checked server alternatives, recovered source-provided subtitle links and marker metadata where available; stop provider cascades during rate limits.
1.1.1: Long-distance seeks and downloads may remain slow. Some episodes fail resolution or decoding; audio-language and native seek certification remain incomplete. No app-code changes.
1.0.4: Added direct Otaku/Vidplay/Playmogo p.a.c.k.e.r embed deobfuscator & direct 1080p CDN HLS resolver with segment validation, fixing playback on Tower of God and other series
1.0.3: Prioritized Neko 1080p Backblaze B2 streams with live segment range probe validation
1.0.2: Built-in automatic HTTP 429 exponential backoff retry engine for flawless rapid browsing
1.0.1: Optimized browser session headers and Referer routing to prevent rate-limiting
1.0.1: Added full Contract V4 discoveryHome and extractHome exports for discovery carousels
1.0.1: Multi-provider failover across koto, kiwi, neko, wave, and megg stream hosts
1.0.0: Official Anikage (anikage.cc) comprehensive anime streaming catalogue with adaptive HD HLS resolution

4.1.3-beta.7: Repairs current embed extraction and refreshes links on reopen/retry; updates the Miruro domain; adds explicit season/part matching guards and stops listing invented playable episodes when the source has none. Owner-approved limited update: sampled media/runtime checks passed; complex aliases remain best-effort, and simulator, physical-device, full-episode and subtitle acceptance remain unverified.
4.1.2: Fixed Re:ZERO search and episode mapping collision with Jujutsu Kaisen using Dice token similarity and season isolation
4.1.2: Added query relevance re-ranking across AniList and Kitsu to prioritize exact series matches over spinoffs and commercials
4.1.2: Resilient multi-provider stream pipeline supporting both direct MP4 and HLS video segments with in-memory stream caching
4.1.2: Robust Kitsu fallback search when AniList is degraded or rate-limited
4.1.0: Owner-approved beta.1 source unchanged; no silent Dub-to-Sub fallback, fresh retry links and exact episode lookup.
4.0.1: Preserve the correct HLS or MP4 type and required headers for each resolved stream

4.2.0: Search now finds titles the way users type them - generated punctuation variants (colon at any word boundary, 'dr.' forms, year parentheses, tail-tokens fallback) plus merged results take the natural-query hit rate to 24/24 (was 22/24) and a season-qualified hard set from 2/8 to 8/8. Season/part variants of a show are grouped and ordered (base, Cour/Part, Season 2, 3..., then specials/OVAs/movies) with release years on cards. The home now serves 6 rows (adds Recently Added, Popular Shows and Coming Soon) in one parallel fan-out. Module icon added.
4.1.0: Correct provider subtitle language labels, including wrapped metadata; unknown tracks are no longer labelled English
4.1.0: Expose usable server alternatives with matching captions and headers; preserve audio-safe Auto quality
4.1.0: Bounded primary recovery and alternate episode-page fallback; 25/30 sampled titles passed media probes, known unavailable titles documented
4.0.3: Official KickAssAnime (kaa.lt) English sub/dub catalogue
